articles.title: The Workforce Barbell: Why Healthcare and Life Science Talent Challenges are Getting Heavier

articles.summary: This report examines the workforce trends reshaping healthcare and life sciences worldwide. Drawing on global labor market data, employer insights, and industry expertise, it explores the forces behind talent shortages, the skills that will shape future success, and the strategies leading organizations are using to attract, develop, and retain critical talent. It also highlights how employers can strengthen workforce resilience through skills-based hiring, workforce transformation, strategic reskilling, and human-centered leadership.
